notes.title: Build Version: 0.352 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Gliding is now implemented. Players can now glide after jumping of a cliff by pressing their jump button in the air (requires sufficient ground clearance)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867751/e552d0a5633701bfb179e0736256a2f138275432.png[/img]

[*] New enemy type (Troll) introduced. The core mechanics are working but will continue to be developed. They have a low chance of spawning at the camps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867751/426d866c5579c11b725767870ccd3b97eb11f683.png[/img]

[*] New character states have been added (Injured, Exhausted and Overencumbered). After dropping below 25%, your character will receive a movement injury penalty. If you have more weight than you can carry, you will also be overencumbered and will not be able to sprint. Certain physical actions will also cost more stamina. If you are out of stamina, you will become exhausted and will not be able to sprint and attacks will be slower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867751/514a47b5598031cc6c36ea29ce9cc135c92a240a.png[/img]

[*] Updated equipment menu

[*] Some collision and falling bugs while on foot or in person now fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Build Version: 0.342 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Small improvements and bug fixes:
1, Fixed bugs with clients not being able to call mount 
2. Improved mount synchronization on clients
3. Improved multiplayer joining logic
4. Fixed UI bug
5. Fixed minor memory leak issues

notes.title: Build Version: 0.34 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Mounts are now available in single player and multiplayer! You can call for your mount by pressing "H". This is the first iteration of mounts so they have no stamina, weight or health (i.e. they can't die). You can also steal another player's mount (but they can still call it back if you try to run away with it)[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867751/effcedeea0249d9706eeed971e2acb2893271ccb.png[/img]

[*] New map, a new map has been designed (only small portion worked on so far). Performance overall is significantly better. The starting area is very different from before and the blacksmith and potion seller are now in different locations. There are two basic enemy camps.

[*] Movement and jumping reworked. However, it will be improved later on

[*] New graphics style, the game's visuals have been updated with improved lighting and artistic direction. 

[*] Miscellaneous bug fixes with a list too long to include
[/list]

notes.title: Build Version: 0.33 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] In-Game Menu has been reworked. There are now 5 menus. Inventory, Equipment, Quests, Stats, Map & Settings. Currently only Inventory, Equipment and Settings are working. The functionality of these menus have been expanded on from previous iterations and additional features such as filters will be added in the next iteration. Within settings you can now save anywhere in the world and start from there in your next play session.

[*] New start system. You will now have the option to start a new game if you have an existing save file. This will delete the current save file so only use this if you are running into bugs. 

[*] Basic potions have been added into the game and can be purchased from the potion seller.

[*] Shop UI has been redesigned

[*] The combat camera has been improved

[*] First iteration of hair and cloth physics implemented (this can be buggy, especially in multiplayer)

[/list]
